warning: Small sample: 0 graded plays (under 50). Record, hit rate and ROI are mostly noise at this size. CLV is the faster check.

definitions.hit_rate: Wins divided by wins plus losses. Pushes are left out.
definitions.roi_pct: Return at the listed American odds if every graded play risked the same stake. Not dollars and not a suggested bet.
definitions.clv_avg_pct: Average of (bet decimal odds × closing no-vig probability − 1), only when the closing line matches the logged line. Positive means the price beat the close.
definitions.model: Average model probability on graded sides, versus how often those sides won. Direction hit is how often a model probability of at least 50% won and under 50% lost. Brier score: lower is better, 0.25 is a coin flip.
